tone.target: bright crunchy alt-rock rhythm with tight drive and slight chorus sheen

tone.summary: A tight signal chain using a Green OD boost and UK 45 amp model with Chorus and minimal Room reverb to achieve a bright, crunchy, dry alt-rock tone.
